title: Plumeform about intro (v2)
description: An about page opening on paper: an eyebrow, a 72px heavy page title and a slate lead, then a wide near-white card with 28px corners split in two, with a small capital label, a large name, a role and a soft pill button at the left, and a few paragraphs ending in an underlined link at the right. The title and card rise and un-blur into view.
notes: place it right after plumeform-v2-header: its top padding leaves room for the floating bar
